facts.fact: The Seychelles Revenue Commission announced the first phase of the ASYCUDA World upgrade to version 4.4.1, conducted by UNCTAD, for 13-14 March 2026, adding trader self-assessment and paperless bill-of-entry processing.
The SRC says traders lodge bills of entry in ASYCUDA, and once payment is confirmed automatic risk-based selectivity assigns red or green clearance lanes.
